# Files from other people

These are copies of files made by others. Do not edit them.

| File | What it is | Where it came from |
|---|---|---|
| `phaser.min.js` | Phaser 4.2.1, the free game toolkit the game is built on. MIT license (see `phaser-LICENSE.md`). | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@4.2.1/dist/phaser.min.js, downloaded 2026-10-11 |

The download was checked against the fingerprint the publisher lists for it
(SHA-256 `ZjSLG1FB5Jt9XrvmiM3ctQLqscsA8hxThoalssWr5N4=`) and against a second copy from unpkg.com.

To move to a newer Phaser, replace the file and test the whole game with the robot play-tester.
